messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-13472 — tokenizer-service p95 > 320ms in us-west-2 (route: /v1/generate). Alert rule: p95 > 250ms for 5m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-13472 :rotating_light:
eli: @channel seeing the same on the dashboard — p95 jump at 16:20 UTC. I'm taking the page (ack).
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-13472 acknowledged by eli.
monica: thanks eli. is this a regional spike or global? any deploys in last 30m?
devon: no deploys from infra in last hour. CI/CD shows no recent tokenizer changes.
sara: confirmed in prometheus: tokenizer_service_request_duration_seconds p95 = 340ms for us-west-2 for the last 5m. p50 unchanged.
eli: looks like queue/backlog — throughput steady but tail latency spiking. can someone check sidecar logs for GC / OOM?
monica: checking pods now: `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=tokenizer -o wide` shows 3 pods, one in `CrashLoopBackOff` (tokenizer-2).
monica: logs from tokenizer-2: ```ERROR [2023-11-27T16:18:41Z] Evicting KV cache entry due to memory pressure
WARN  [2023-11-27T16:19:05Z] batch_size exceeded target, processing backlog
OOMKilled```
devon: hmm OOM on one replica could cause tail effects if batching pins other requests. traffic split is 100% to primary pool in us-west-2.
eli: immediate mitigation options: scale tokenizer replicas, reduce batch sizes, or fail-over some traffic to eu-west-1 fallback model variant. what's fastest?
monica: scaling is fastest. I'm going to scale to 5 replicas and set `max_batch_size` to 8 on the live config.
monica: Running: ```kubectl scale deploy/tokenizer -n prod --replicas=5```
monica: Also patching configmap: ```kubectl patch configmap/tokenizer-config -n prod --patch '{"data":{"max_batch_size":"8"}}'```
monica: done. pods are spinning up (2 -> 5).
eli: adding temporary traffic split to send 20% to eu-west-1. Command: `infractl route split --service tokenizer --region us-west-2=80 --region eu-west-1=20`
devon: executing now. route change applied.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-13472 — note: routing change detected by infra control plane.
sara: within 90s p95 dropped to ~210ms in us-west-2; global p95 now ~190ms. still noisy but much better.
eli: nice. monitoring for regressions. can we also enable KV cache eviction telemetry to track if eviction rate went up?
monica: enabling extra metrics/sidecar logs — toggled `KV_CACHE_METRICS=true` via configmap patch.
monica: pushing new sidecar image with a lighter memory footprint to tokenizer-2 to prevent another OOM. will do a rolling restart.```

devon: rolling restart started: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/tokenizer -n prod` — monitoring.
eli: checking customer impact — any errors surfaced in support queue or increased 5xx?
sara: support metrics: error-rate small bump, 500s increased from 0.02% -> 0.18% in us-west-2 during the spike window. Only a handful of customer requests affected.
monica: sent note to SEs: "we're mitigating a p95 spike due to tokenizer OOM; rolling restart & scale applied; routing 20% to eu-west-1" in #customer-impact.
eli: good. keep pagers updated and aim to have PD incident transitioned to 'monitoring' if stable for 15m.
sara: current graphs: p95 us-west-2: 195ms; p99 630ms (tail still present but decreasing).
devon: any idea root cause — memory leak vs sudden traffic shape? from logs it's KV cache memory pressure then OOM. Could be skewed long prefix requests causing large KV caches.
monica: grep on request sizes shows a burst of long-context requests from a single client IP range ~16:17–16:19. Flagging for rate-limits team.
eli: noted. can we set a temporary prefix-length cap or rate-limit for that IP range?
sara: added a quick ACL rule: `ingressctl block --ip-range 54.120.0.0/16 --limit 30r/s` — applied.
monica: after ACL, the p99 dropped to 280ms.
eli: team — plan for next steps: 1) keep replicas=5 for 1h then evaluate 2) investigate long-context request pattern and adjust quota/rate-limits 3) instrument KV cache evictions and memory usage per pod 4) postmortem if we find leak.
devon: +1. I'll open a dedicated ticket and assign to infra/serving.
monica: I'll follow up with a short incident-summary for the Ops channel and tag the affected customer accounts.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-13472 status changed to Monitoring by eli.
incident-bot: Incident PD-13472 resolved (monitoring -> resolved) after 45m. Summary: OOM on one tokenizer replica caused p95 tail; mitigations: scaled replicas, reduced max_batch_size, routed 20% traffic to eu-west-1, applied ACL to noisy IP-range, rolled lighter sidecar image. No sustained customer outage; minor 5xx bump for ~6m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-13472
eli: thanks all. I'll draft the postmortem and we can sync tomorrow 11:00 UTC if needed. :thumbsup:
monica: thanks, great teamwork. :rocket:
devon: adding follow-up ticket: INFRA-2219 - tokenizer KV cache memory accounting + eviction alerts.
sara: logging incident details to runbook and closing thread."
